carnival_games_minigolf_v0.1.0.description:
Initial release of the *Carnival Games MiniGolf* Archipelago.

This release adds *Carnival Games MiniGolf* as a playable Archipelago world with:
- Random Starting World and Goal World
- World unlocks
- Hole Completion checks
- Hole-in-One checks
- Minigame Win and Perfect checks
- Barker Coin checks
- World Secret checks
- Pro Shop and Barker Shop checks
- Universal Tracker support

...and much more (see full list in [Carnival Games MiniGolf Game Info](worlds/carnival_games_minigolf/docs/en_Carnival%20Games%20MiniGolf.md))

Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer, Dolphin Emulator, and the **PAL** version of Carnival Games MiniGolf (`RG9P54`).
(see [Setup Guide](worlds/carnival_games_minigolf/docs/setup_en.md) for how to play)

I've tested the apworld extensively, including its different option combinations, generation logic, and Universal Tracker support, and it should be ready for APs with your friends.
But still be cautious, there can always be little things that I might've not noticed while testing.
If you do find bugs or have suggestions for this AP, make sure to join the official Archipelago Discord server and tell me your regards in the Carnival Games MiniGolf thread under Future Game Design.
